fields.topology_type: Point-to-point only — 1 source (sensor / display TX / serializer) ↔ 1 sink (application processor / ISP / deserializer) per physical interface. No bus, no daisy chain, no multi-drop.

supported_topologies.name: Single source ↔ single sink
supported_topologies.description: Canonical CSI-2 link; one camera module to one host.

supported_topologies.name: Multi-stream via Virtual Channel
supported_topologies.description: One physical D-PHY interface carries up to 4 (v1.1) / 16 (v1.2+) Virtual Channels; allows time-multiplexing of multiple logical sources.

supported_topologies.name: External MIPI aggregator / serializer
supported_topologies.description: Some vendors offer aggregators (e.g. multi-camera-to-one-CSI-2) but the physical CSI-2 link itself is still point-to-point.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Image sensor / display TX / serializer; drives Clock Lane DDR + Data Lane HS payload; initiates HS Entry / Exit.
Application processor / ISP / deserializer; receives HS payload; decodes CSI-2 packets; may participate in LP escape (e.g. ULPS exit handshake).
I2C / SCCB master (on the host SoC side) that configures the sensor over a SEPARATE bus — gain, exposure, ROI, VC/DT/lane-count select.

fields.interconnect_role: There is no protocol-layer router or hub. The link is a flat point-to-point pair (Clock Lane + N Data Lanes). Aggregation across multiple cameras happens at the host SoC's multi-port CSI-2 RX subsystem, not on the D-PHY wires.

ordering_guarantees.within_a_packet: Bytes transmitted byte-0 first; within each byte, LSB-first on the wire.
ordering_guarantees.within_a_frame: FS at start → LS+Long+LE per line → FE at end; receiver enforces ordering via DT field.
ordering_guarantees.across_VCs: VCs interleave at packet boundary; no ordering between VCs.
ordering_guarantees.across_lanes: byte k → lane (k mod N); receiver de-interleaves by lane index and timestamps with Clock-Lane edges.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Not applicable — CSI-2 is a streaming protocol; no addressable memory or register region on the CSI-2 wires themselves. Sensor registers live on the sideband I2C bus.

device_classification.image_sensor: Source; drives Clock Lane + Data Lane HS payload.
device_classification.display_panel: Source (when using DSI which shares D-PHY); drives Clock + Data HS payload toward the panel.
device_classification.application_processor: Sink; integrates CSI-2 RX + DSI TX subsystems.
device_classification.ISP / image processor: Sink; consumes CSI-2 packets; may include de-Bayer, color, etc.
device_classification.MIPI bridge / serializer: Both source and sink; converts MIPI-CSI-2 to other formats (e.g. GMSL, FPD-Link).
